ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85-90 percent high-intensity white pixels vs 10-15 percent low-intensity black pixels localized on the perimeter and focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black band along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (focal spots) distributed across the white field, notably at [x:0.18, y:0.42], [x:0.48, y:0.78], and [x:0.65, y:0.52].

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 70-80 degree internal pixel angle and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration; continuous series of peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 4 and 18 pixels along the black trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curve originating from the median notch and terminating at the pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme left and right tips, consistent with barnacle-induced scarring. Small circular dark pixel clusters scattered on the interior ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, near-parallel diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe extending from the mid-section toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent diagonal linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular jagged tissue loss at both the extreme left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized pink/reddish low-saturation pigmentation patches visible on the lower-central region of the right lobe.
